headlines.title: Is Defense Backlog Growth Altering The Investment Case For Boeing (BA)?
headlines.summary: Boeing reported continued losses per share for the third quarter and first nine months of 2026, while its defense segment and total backlog reached record levels, and the 737-10 obtained FAA certification under the 2020 Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act.

headlines.title: Why Is Boeing (BA) Pushing Deeper Into Cargo And Airline Data Tools?
headlines.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) has agreed with Iceland based lessor Icelease to convert 767-300 passenger aircraft into dedicated freighters. The two sides plan a multi aircraft conversion program that feeds additional 767-300 freighters into the air cargo market. Boeing also introduced Dataliner, an AI powered data intelligence platform for airline customers, developed in partnership with Microsoft.

headlines.title: Boeing secures lessor order for 767 passenger-to-freighter conversion
headlines.summary: Boeing will convert a 767-300 passenger jet into a freighter for Icelease, which also took options for up to two more conversions, as the leasing company continues to grow its freighter portfolio, the companies announced on Monday. headlines.title: Boeing and Icelease Sign Agreement for up to Three 767-300 Boeing Converted Freighters
headlines.summary: Boeing [NYSE: BA] and Icelease agreed to an order for one 767-300 Boeing Converted Freighter (BCF) and options for up to two more as the leasing company continues to grow its freighter portfolio.

headlines.title: Cramer thinks Boeing’s problems aren’t going away soon, says buy GE
headlines.summary: The CNBC host sees diverging outlooks for GE Aerospace and Boeing.

description: The Boeing Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, services, and supports commercial jetliners, military aircraft, satellites, missile defense, human space flight and launch systems, and services worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Airplanes; Defense, Space & Security; and Global Services. The Commercial Airplanes segment develops, produces, and markets commercial jet aircraft for passenger and cargo requirements. The Defense, Space & Security segment engages in the research, development, production, and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems; strategic defense and intelligence systems, which include strategic missile and defense systems, command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, cyber and information solutions, and intelligence systems; and satellite systems, such as government and commercial satellites, and space exploration. The Global Services segment offers products and services, including supply chain and logistics management, engineering, maintenance and modifications, upgrades and conversions, spare parts, pilot and maintenance training systems and services, technical and maintenance documents, and data analytics and digital services to commercial and defense customers. The Boeing Company was incorporated in 1916 and is based in Arlington, Virginia.
